title: Metadata catalog tables & seed CLI

user_story.i_want: the sources and catalog tables created and seeded from a versioned file
user_story.so_that: categorisation rules live as data, not code

description: Add `stratum-cli catalog init`, which creates `stratum-sources` (PK source_id) and `stratum-catalog` (PK source_id, SK name) if absent. It is idempotent and uses on-demand billing. `stratum-cli catalog seed deploy/seed/catalog.toml` validates the file, then upserts with BatchWriteItem (25 items per call, retrying UnprocessedItems). The seed has at least 4 sources (one per product_type) and at least 10 catalog entries across metric/event/log, including one entry with `drop_fields = ["email"]`. `stratum-cli catalog get <source_id> [name]` prints an item.

acceptance_criteria.then: items are upserted and the second run changes nothing; editing a value and re-seeding updates it
the unprocessed items are retried with backoff
it fails before writing anything and names the entry

acceptance_criteria.when: I read them with the AWS CLI against localhost:8000

rust_concepts: toml + serde for the seed file
